Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Query ServiceOrders for the current scope ($$KANBAN_SCOPE) and push a per-column paginated JSON payload + meta to the kanban web viewer wv_ServiceOrdersKanban.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: SCOPE: $$KANBAN_SCOPE = {"periodMode":"day|week|month","anchorDate":"YYYY-MM-DD","statuses":[...],"query":"...","initialSize":N,"pageStep":N,"loaded":{status:N,...}}. Empty/missing keys fall back to day / today / [] / "" / 20 / 10 / {}. "loaded" maps a status to how many cards that column currently reveals (absent = initialSize). PAYLOAD (v3 contract): { orders: [ { id, number, status, customer, phone, plate, make, model, year, service, note, date, timeStart, timeEnd, rush, price } ], meta: { periodMode, anchorDate, from, to, label, statuses, query, total, pageStep, columns: { status: { loaded, available } } } } Statuses 'U toku', 'Obračunat' and 'Fakturisan' are pinned — always on the board regardless of the date window. The search query filters everything, pinned rows included. Each status column is paginated independently: one GROUP BY count query + one FETCH FIRST {loaded} SELECT per non-empty column.

Value.Calculation: Let ( ~p = JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "periodMode" ) ; If ( IsEmpty ( ~p ) or Left ( ~p ; 1 ) = "?" ; "day" ; ~p ) )
Let ( ~a = JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "anchorDate" ) ; If ( IsEmpty ( ~a ) or Left ( ~a ; 1 ) = "?" ; $today ; ~a ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Compute date window (from/to) from periodMode + anchorDate

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Build WHERE — pinned statuses OR (date window + optional status filter), then search across all of it

Value.Calculation: " FROM ServiceOrders so" & " LEFT OUTER JOIN Vehicles v ON v.PrimaryKey = so.ForeignKeyVehicle" & " LEFT OUTER JOIN Clients c ON c.PrimaryKey = so.ForeignKeyClient"
" WHERE ( so.Status IN ( 'U toku', 'Obračunat', 'Fakturisan' )" & " OR ( so.JobDate BETWEEN DATE '" & $fromISO & "' AND DATE '" & $toISO & "'" & $statusClause & " ) )" & $searchClause

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Per-column counts — one GROUP BY gives every column's available total

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT so.Status, COUNT(*)" & $sqlFrom & $where & " GROUP BY so.Status" ; "useSQLResult=rs_counts" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Persist normalized scope (per-column loaded map; no global offset)

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Per-column paginated SELECT — one FETCH FIRST {loaded} query per non-empty status column (v3 card contract)

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT so.PrimaryKey, so.ServiceOrderNumber, so.Status, so.ClientName_Calculation, c.Phone," & " v.PlateNumber, v.Manufacturer, v.Model, v.YearManufactured," & " so.Description, so.Remarks, so.JobDate, so.JobTime, so.JobTimeEnd," & " so.RushOrder_Flag, so.OrderTotalLive_Calculation" & $sqlFrom & $where & " AND so.Status = " & epSQLQuote ( $curStatus ) & " ORDER BY so.JobDate, so.JobTime" & " OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH FIRST " & $target & " ROWS ONLY" ; "useSQLResult=rs_kanban" )

Step.Text: MARK: Build payload (orders + meta) and push to the web viewer
